author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sunward Scimitar
summary: A curved blade that glows faintly in sunlight and harries the undead.
description: Its edge is polished until it throws a small spot of light on whatever it points at. Desert caravans carry them as much for comfort as for defense.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit an Undead with it, the target takes an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.
